svg.title: FairLend — Responsible Ai
svg.desc: Measures proxy discrimination in mortgage credit decisions, constrains it with Fairlearn and explains each applicant's outcome with SHAP. Rounded DPR 0.903 for the mitigated model in the documented HMDA research benchmark; not the synthetic demo or a legal certification.
